baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from the collective loss report through the finder clause to the singular guarantor clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken report of absence becomes a public recovery contract: identify the missing royal measure, bring it, receive a quantified cargo, and rely on one speaker's personal surety.

activation_trace.role: Vocalized speech gives the announcement public and performative force.
Loss after prior presence supplies the condition that opens the recovery transaction.
Seeking what has gone absent turns the report into an implicit call for search and return.
A vessel used as a measure specifies both the missing object and its economic function.
Royal authority makes the loss public business rather than a private misplaced item.
Bringing and presenting the object defines the act that earns the reward.
A visible carried load gives the promised payment a concrete transport scale.
The camel fixes the carrying unit used to quantify the reward.
Personal surety closes the offer by assigning liability for its fulfillment.

changed_reading.before: The speakers merely report a missing royal cup and append a reward.
changed_reading.after: The utterance is a compact public contract whose loss, recovery act, payment unit, and liable guarantor are all specified.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of the camel-load and the first-person guarantor.
baseline_models.mechanism: The physical burden promised as payment is shadowed by a juridical burden: the speaker not only names a load but assumes responsibility for making that load due.

activation_trace.role: The externally carried cargo supplies the literal burden promised to the finder.
The same root's guarantee and liability branch converts cargo-bearing into obligation-bearing.
The guarantor explicitly shoulders the obligation latent in the reward's load.

changed_reading.before: The load is only the size of the prize, and the guarantee is a separate assurance.
changed_reading.after: The verse overlays a carried load with a carried liability, so the reward and the guarantor form one burden-transfer image.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The missing measuring vessel answered by a camel-load.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object's measuring function migrates into the reward: loss of a measure is answered with a measured transport quantity, making compensation formally resemble what is missing.

activation_trace.role: The missing object is not merely a cup but an instrument that defines quantity.
The reward is expressed as an amount that can be carried rather than as an abstract value.
The pack animal supplies the practical unit by which that amount is reckoned.

changed_reading.before: An unrelated bounty compensates whoever returns the vessel.
changed_reading.after: A measuring object is exchanged for a transport measure, creating a measure-for-measure symmetry inside the offer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tension between the collective declaration and the speaker's emphatic surety.
baseline_models.mechanism: Branches of circulated or falsely attributed speech and assertion without certainty cast an ironic shadow over the direct guarantee sense: confident publicity does not itself settle whether the reported loss is innocent or fully transparent.

activation_trace.role: Speech attributed beyond what was actually said opens a contained possibility that the announcement is constructed rather than transparent.
A saying spread among people gives the claim the force of an official public narrative.
Assertion under uncertainty shadows the otherwise direct noun of guarantee with epistemic instability.
Actual surety keeps the uncertain claim accountable instead of letting it remain mere rumor.

changed_reading.before: The announcement transparently states an accidental loss.
changed_reading.after: The statement can also be heard as an accountable but potentially managed public claim whose confident form exceeds its disclosed knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier exchanges repeatedly make bringing a brother the condition for receiving grain measure, and explicitly name an added camel's measure. The focus offer reverses the slots but preserves the machine: bring the object and receive a camel-scaled quantity.

activation_trace.role: Giving or delivering the requested brother supplies the first bring-X side of the exchange pattern.
Measured food supplies the consideration offered in return for that delivery.
Failure to arrive with the requested person states the exchange condition negatively.
Withheld measure states the consequence of failing that condition.
Repeated food measurement culminates in the exact expectation of an additional quantified ration.
The camel already serves as the unit for the additional ration later echoed by the focus reward.
Presentation of the missing object occupies the delivery slot in the replayed exchange.
The promised carried quantity occupies the payment slot in the replayed exchange.
The repeated camel unit makes the replay lexically and materially visible.

structural_cues: The same conditional economy recurs as bring X, then receive or lose measure.
The focus reverses the earlier direction of exchange while preserving its quantity vocabulary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated bringing, measuring, and camel-unit language; I infer deliberate transactional replay. A live alternative is ordinary reuse of grain-trade vocabulary without a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: The camel-load is an independently chosen bounty for a lost object.
changed_reading.after: The bounty replays and reverses the earlier bargain over the brother: another bring-X-for-measure transaction now uses the promised camel unit as bait.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first-person guarantor enters a local chain of pledged return, solemn covenant, and entrusted oversight. Its force is therefore heavier than a casual assurance of payment.

activation_trace.role: A formally confirmed covenant establishes the nearby standard for binding a speaker to future return.
An agent who stands over an affair for sufficiency and preservation supplies the oversight role behind the guarantee.
Liability-bearing makes the promised cargo an obligation rather than only an amount.
The singular speaker takes personal responsibility within the already activated covenantal field.

structural_cues: A first-person pledge follows a sequence dominated by promises about bringing and returning a person.
The shift from collective speech to singular liability isolates one responsible voice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covenant and custodial-agency language; I infer a recursive chain of sureties culminating in the announcer. Alternatively, the reward guarantee may remain a separate commercial convention with no transfer from the earlier oath.

changed_reading.before: The final clause simply reassures listeners that the prize will be paid.
changed_reading.after: The announcer becomes another link in a chain of pledged custody, so guaranteeing cargo echoes the graver guarantee of a brother's return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recognition is asymmetrical, the drinking vessel is deliberately placed, and a herald publicly attributes theft. Against that sequence, 'we are missing' remains operationally usable for a search party but no longer reads as a transparent account of accidental disappearance.

activation_trace.role: Recognition by a distinguishing sign supplies one side of the scene's controlled knowledge asymmetry.
Failure to recognize supplies the other side, leaving the visitors unable to read the controller of events.
Deliberately putting the object into a chosen state and location makes its absence managed rather than accidental.
The drinking function identifies the planted item as a vessel before the focus names its measuring function.
Public notification converts hidden placement into an official audible narrative.
Attribution of theft supplies the accusation that the later loss report operationalizes.
Circulated public speech carries the managed account through the group.
Searching for an absent item remains locally true even when another agent caused the absence.
The measuring vessel anchors the proclaimed loss to the object already planted as a drinking vessel.

structural_cues: Private placement precedes public accusation and public specification of the loss.
Knowledge is distributed unevenly between the planner, attendants, and accused travelers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recognition asymmetry, deliberate placement, and public accusation; I infer that the focus utterance functions inside a staged search. A live alternative is that the announcing attendants literally experience the object as missing and speak without knowledge of the plan.

changed_reading.before: The speakers discover an accidental loss and accurately describe its cause-neutral state.
changed_reading.after: The statement is a procedurally effective loss claim inside managed ignorance: true enough to launch a search, but downstream from concealed placement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two rounds of provisioning place valuable material into travel containers: merchandise is secretly returned in the travelers' gear, then the drinking vessel is placed in one brother's gear. The focus loss is the public face of a repeated hidden-container operation.

activation_trace.role: Intentional emplacement initiates the first concealed transfer into the travelers' equipment.
Trade property becomes the valuable material secretly recirculated rather than retained.
Pack gear on a camel supplies the first container for the hidden valuable.
A second deliberate emplacement repeats the same material operation with a different object.
The drinking vessel becomes the second valuable inserted into the cargo system.
The repeated pack-container localizes the second transfer to one selected traveler.
Public absence is produced by the object's concealed relocation rather than destruction.
The vessel-measure is the movable item that turns concealed circulation into announced loss.

structural_cues: Returned merchandise and the planted vessel occupy parallel positions inside travel gear.
Both hidden transfers occur during provisioning and are discovered only after departure or search.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two deliberate placements into pack containers; I infer a repeated controlled-circulation tactic whose second instance weaponizes discovery. Alternatively, the parallel may be narrative economy rather than a mechanism the focus wording itself invites.

changed_reading.before: The missing vessel is an isolated object in a single theft inquiry.
changed_reading.after: Its disappearance is the second cycle of a controlled cargo system: valuables move secretly into travelers' containers, then reappear with changed social consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reward's finder conditional opens into a penalty conditional: the travelers themselves state that the person in whose container the object is found becomes recompense, enabling a planned taking under a rule other than the king's ordinary regime.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal consequence turns the object inquiry from recovery into adjudication.
One party standing in place of another as recompense supplies the substitution by which a found object yields custody of a person.
Discovery in a container becomes the evidentiary hinge that activates the stated penalty.
Strategic contrivance links the staged search to its intended custodial result.
Seizure and detention state the human outcome concealed behind the object-recovery procedure.
An operative custom or regime marks the jurisdictional constraint the procedure must route around.
Royal rule supplies the institutional frame under which direct seizure was unavailable.
The finder who presents the object begins the conditional chain later completed by discovery and penalty.
Naming the object as royal lends institutional authority to the inquiry while the later procedure bypasses ordinary royal law.
The guaranteed reward stabilizes participation in the procedure that will produce the decisive finding.

structural_cues: The finder-relative clause in the focus is followed by a found-in-whose-container relative clause.
Object recovery, penalty declaration, sequential search, and personal seizure form one procedural chain.
The object bears royal ownership while the resulting custody depends on a non-royal rule supplied by the travelers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reward, penalty exchange, discovery, strategy, seizure, and jurisdictional contrast; I infer that the bounty call helps stage the route to custody. A live alternative is that the reward is a genuine independent offer and only the later penalty exchange performs the legal work.

changed_reading.before: The announcement seeks only restoration of royal property and offers payment for assistance.
changed_reading.after: The recovery offer is the opening move of a jurisdictional device in which finding property is converted into authority to take a person.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from the focus speech root to a form-distant carrying branch. It remains anchored at the opening utterance and is reinforced by explicit load and surety roots, but downstream prose should mark it as a phonolexical burden resonance, not the ordinary lexical sense of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The collective opening utterance followed by a promised load and a singular guarantor.

activation_trace.role: The split-root branch of lifting and bearing recasts the spoken announcement itself as an assumed load.
Bearing an entrusted obligation gives the speech-load a juridical rather than merely acoustic weight.
The singular guarantor becomes the person who shoulders what the collective voice has raised.

changed_reading.before: The group speaks, then one member independently guarantees the reward.
changed_reading.after: The utterance itself can be heard as lifting a burden that passes from collective proclamation to singular personal liability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the dispersal and corralling branches behind the vessel's root rather than its direct utensil sense. It remains anchored in the named object and in the visible sequence of separated entrances, enclosed containers, and extraction, but should be rendered as structural resonance, not as a claim that the noun literally means a trap.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The named measure at the center of a sequence that disperses the group and isolates one container-holder.

activation_trace.role: Dispersal and splitting let the vessel resonate as an instrument whose narrative effect is to break group cohesion.
Driving a group from its sides supplies the complementary image of controlling and redistributing the travelers.
Ordered separation into parts establishes the spatial pattern later exploited by the object search.
A sequence of enclosing vessels partitions the collective cargo into individually searchable units.
Bringing the concealed object out of one container converts partition into the isolation of one brother.

changed_reading.before: The measure is passive evidence located during a search.
changed_reading.after: At a contained structural level, the measure acts as a separation technology: it reorganizes a caravan into containers, findings, and one isolated person.

strongest_changes: The camel-load offer replays and reverses the earlier bring-for-measure bargain, including the already expected camel unit.
The loss report changes from accidental description into a usable public claim downstream from concealed placement and unequal knowledge.
Object recovery becomes the opening of an adjudicative device that converts a finding into custody under a chosen rule.
The guarantor clause joins a preceding chain of covenants, custodianship, and liability rather than serving as casual reassurance.
summary.what_was_special: A short commercial proclamation is overdetermined by metrology, burden, surety, hidden container transfers, public knowledge management, and jurisdictional capture. The packet's split mapping also preserves a contained reading in which speech itself becomes a burden carried by the guarantor.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the announcing attendants know the placement or literally experience the vessel as missing.
Whether the promised bounty is meant to be payable or primarily to recruit participation in the staged search.
Whether the non-dominant speech-to-bearing mapping reflects a productive latent resonance or only a form-distant packet affordance.
How strongly the separation branches of the vessel root should be heard beyond the direct measure-and-container sense.
